/* Formatted on 9/16/2026 3:29:00 PM (QP5 v5.362) */
  SELECT RAWTOHEX (t.DOCUMENT_ID)     DOCUMENT_ID,
         t.FILE_NAME,
         t.MIME_TYPE,
         t.FILE_SIZE,
         t.DOCUMENT_REF,
         t.DOCUMENT_STATUS,
         t.VALIDATION_STATUS,
         t.CREATED_BY,
         t.UPDATED_BY,
         t.DOCUMENT_TYPE,
         RAWTOHEX (t.request_id)      REQUEST_ID
    FROM MMS_ONBOARDING_DOCUMENT t
   WHERE     t.REQUEST_ID = '{{JS_PAGE.getRequestId()}}'
         AND NVL (t.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
ORDER BY t.UPDATED_AT DESC
